definition: Neither source describes Still directly; it appears as a named point of reference alongside their own contributions. QuRL instead runs RLVR's rollout phase with an INT8/FP8 quantized actor for 20-80% faster rollout; ShorterBetter rewards matching the shortest correct response length in a sampled group, cutting output length 50-80% on DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B.

evidence.note: ShorterBetter takes the length of the shortest correct response in a sampled group as a per-problem target and rewards the model for matching it, cutting output length by 50%-80% on DeepSeek-Distill-Qwen-1.5B/7B.
evidence.title: ShorterBetter: Guiding Reasoning Models to Find Optimal Inference Length for Efficient Reasoning
